spl_product_data_elements: Hand Recovery Alcohol ALCOHOL ALCOHOL Water
warnings: For external use only. Flammable. Keep away from children.
when_using: Do not use in or near eyes. In case of eye contact, rinse thoroughly with water.
stop_use: If redness or irritation develop and persist for more than 72 hours.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Apply lotion directly onto body and rub with hands until dry. Product may be used on all skin surfaces. Children under 6 years of age should be supervised when using this product.
indications_and_usage: Apply lotion directly onto body and rub with hands until dry. Product may be used on all skin surfaces. Children under 6 years of age should be supervised when using this product.
other_safety_information: Do not store above 110oF (43oC). For additional information, see Safety Data Sheet (SDS).
inactive_ingredient: Glycereth-18 (and) glycereth-18 ethylhexanoate, PEG-10 dimethicone, PEG-75 lanolin, ethylene glycol distearate, acrylate crosspolymer, 2-amino-2-methyl-1-propanol, water (aqua), PEG 1450, cocamide MEA
questions: Call 1-888-300-1225, Monday through Friday 8:00AM to 5:00PM EST/EDT.
